text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan tells Organisation of Islamic Conference (OIC) of "need to correct Islam's image in the world".
- Morocco and Spain connection of electricity grids anchors the North African country to Europe.
- Fuel station workers stage one-day strike to press for revision of contracts with supply companies.
- Marrakesh international water forum vows to devise strategy for rational use of water before the year 2000.
- Casablanca signs accord with French city of Bordeaux for electronic system regulating road traffic.
- Number of countries supporting Saharan Democratic Republic (SADR) shrinks after Benin's decision to withdraw recognition.
- France is no more promised land for Moroccans. Number of migrants fell to 6,290 in 1995 from 7,883 the year before.
